title: Termination after the unary budget
statement: Let $W$ be a finite binary Turing machine, let $a,R,B\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $x$ be an input word over the schedule alphabet. For a base configuration of the schedule machine on $x$, suppose its guide tape is the fixed guide of radius $R$, its unary tape contains unit markers at every coordinate $j+1$ for $j<B$, and its unary cell at coordinate $B+1$ is blank. Starting in the macrostep-check phase with unary head at $1$ and guide head at $0$, after exactly $B(6R+8)+1$ steps the machine is halted, with unary head at $B+1$ and guide head at $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $W$ is a finite binary Turing machine
$x$ is an input word over the schedule alphabet
the base guide tape is the fixed guide of radius $R$
for every natural $j<B$, the unary tape contains a unit marker at coordinate $j+1$
the unary cell at coordinate $B+1$ is blank
replaced:
Suppose the base's guide tape is the fixed guide of radius $R$, its unary tape holds
unit markers at all coordinates $1, 2, \dots, B$, and the unary cell at coordinate
$B + 1$ is blank.  Then running the schedule controller for $B\,(6R + 8) + 1$ steps
from the counter-test phase with unary head at $1$ and guide head at the origin ends
in the halted phase with unary head at $B + 1$ and guide head at the origin: the
schedule finishes after exactly the budgeted macrosteps plus one final counter test.
